text:
```yaml
name: Regenerate Translations

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  regenerate-translations:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          flutter pub get

      - name: Activate intl_utils
        run: |
          flutter pub global activate intl_utils

      - name: Generate Translations
        run: |
          flutter pub global run intl_utils:generate

      - name: Check for Changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and Push Changes
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changes == 'true'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Regenerate translations"
          git push origin HEAD:regenerate-translations-${{ github.run_id }}

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check_changes.outputs.changes == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: regenerate-translations-${{ github.run_id }}
          title: "Regenerate translations"
          body: "This PR was automatically created to regenerate translation files."
          base: main
```
